notes.title: Journal Update
notes.content:
Are you ready? You're going to be our next best-selling writer for backrooms with your very own journal! And begin to feel relieved with Mary the Flowergirl! A dreamy way is waiting for you!

UPDATES:
- Journal Mechanic has added to the game.
- Journal Points section has added to the escape qualifications.
New Entity : Mary
She's coming to be your daydreamer guide!
- Mary has added to Almanac.
- Profile Information is now accessible in game!

GAME CHANGES:
- Main Menu changes.
- Character bug fixes.
- Level 0 design changes.
- Turkish language translate changes.

MULTIPLAYER:
- Multiplayer gamemode is disabled due to connection errors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45467576/57693e13a9ec2c46052a9a1bde0d951b8dbb9d88.png[/img]

notes.title: New Combat Mechanics and Turkish Language Support
notes.content:
Backrooms: The Yellow Dream gets a cool update! Where players can now fight monsters face to face! And with new language support we hope that this will reach more players!

UPDATES:
- New Punching system has added to the game.
- Turkish language has added to the game.
- Subtitles are now available on both languages.

GAME CHANGES:
- Bug fixes on guns.
- Some animation fixes.
- Water and Food bar decrease rate slowed.
   * Water 1 sec ---> 2 sec
   * Food 2 sec ---> 4 sec
- Hitbox changes on entities.
- Hound's voice got lower.
- Concrete footstep sounds has changed
